_comment: Web app download budgets in bytes (issue #969, ADR-046 item 9). Gzip level 9 of the files a first visit fetches. first_frame_ms is the Node instantiate-to-first-frame bound, a generous regression tripwire not a performance claim. gallery_web (issue #1023) also budgets data_gzip, the preloaded CSS, theme and font a first visit fetches as app.data; its wasm carries the text (FreeType, HarfBuzz), vector (ThorVG) and layout stacks, so the bound is about 15 percent over the measured 1.52 MB.
